verification_scope: The Wall theorem is stated for closed smooth oriented (n-1)-connected 2n-manifolds; all diffeomorphisms preserve orientation. For n=4 the middle lattice and normal-bundle function determine the connected-sum orbit under Theta8. The receiving proof reconstructs the rank-four normal clutching class from its Euler and Pontryagin numbers: (a,b) maps to (a-b,-2(a+b)), an injective homomorphism. Thus matching intersection forms and p1 matches the full n-space, not merely its stable rational image.
limits: The classification statement is credited to Wall in this research paper. No use is made of the high-dimensional inertia remark2.7 or of the paper’s asymptotic main theorem, neither of which supplies the dimension-eight inertia conclusion.

verification_scope: E1.3 uses the C3=0 family after the finite deck-lattice cover 2Z^3. The already printed properness proof and unimodular toric charts give a proper holomorphic map, smooth away from0, with smooth total space and SNC central fibre. The strictly coherent positive quadratic function Q=4 sum n_i^2-(sum n_i)^2 supplies a relative projective polarization, hence a Kähler total space over the disc. These are Chen’s exact hypotheses. Complex surjectivity onto monodromy invariants implies rational surjectivity by scalar extension; finite deck invariants are exact over Q.
limits: Chen is not used as an integral invariant-cycle theorem. Integral surjectivity in E1.3 is established separately by the printed line-bundle descent, wedge products and saturated kernel calculation. The pure-weight degeneration of the normalization complex is a separate Deligne source gate.
